title: Apple Inc. - Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
text:
Company: Apple Inc.
Ticker: AAPL
CIK: 0000320193
Taxonomy: us-gaap
Concept: ExcessTaxBenefitFromShareBasedCompensationFinancingActivities
Label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
Description: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.
